 T-groove plates 
 T-groove plates
T-groove plates are used for testing components, among other things. They can be optionally extended with an air cushion pallet and parking table for moving heavy fixtures in and out of the test area. This makes it easier to switch between different test types. They are available in different sizes and different T-groove geometries.
